title: Network plan
description: An IPv4 network plan: the address space, its segments, the blocks inside each segment, and the devices. ipplan check enforces the address rules this schema can't express (overlaps, boundaries, pools).

name.description: What this plan is for, such as a site or customer name.

address_space.description: Ranges every segment must fit inside. Leave it out to skip that check.

segment.description: One subnet, usually one VLAN, with one purpose.

id.description: Short unique key, such as users.

site.description: Which site this segment belongs to. VLAN numbers only have to be unique within a site.

purpose.description: Who and what lives here, and what it may reach.

block.description: A run of addresses inside a segment set aside for one job.

kind.description: fixed: set by hand or by DHCP reservation. pool: handed out by DHCP. spare: held for later.

ip.description: The planned address. Optional for dynamic devices.

current_ip.description: Where it is today, when it has to move.

how.description: static: set on the device. reserved: a DHCP reservation. dynamic: any pool address. retire: going away.

gateway.description: True for the device that is the segment's gateway.
